messages:
marta: Newridge ASIC perf kickoff - partner wants joint perf/W report and a reproducible kernel tuning recipe. Lee/Zane can you outline the minimal sweep?
lee: Suggest baseline + tuned. Baseline: seq=1024, batch=8, power=120W. Tuned: seq=2048, batch 4/8, power 80/120/160W. Quant variants: int8, q4_0. Collect p50/p95/p99, power samples at 5Hz, and per-token energy. Need partner-provided kernel patches or hardware straps documented.
zane: We'll instrument pmu counters and nvml. Lab available Fri afternoon. Ops-bot: Reserving bench slot 2026-03-19 14:00-17:00 PT.
marta: Please add acceptance criteria: perf/W improves >=10% at 120W or tail latency p99 < 250ms for seq=2048. Partner asked for concise one-pager and CSV outputs.
lee: I'll author the runbook including commands and kernel boot flags. Example boot flags: "mitigations=off isolcpus=2-5 nohz_full=2-5 rcu_nocbs=2-5". Run tool: ./bench_harness --model newridge-7b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --quant int8 --powercap 120 --output s3://redwood-bench/newridge/1716604321/
zane: Dataset: 1k synthetic prompts stored at /data/bench/newridge/1000.jsonl.gz. I'll stage artifacts and verify checksums.
bench-bot: JIRA INF-8022 created, label=partner-newridge. Tag experiments with "newridge-2026-q1".
marta: Ops, ensure rack power meter calibration and firmware noted in run metadata. Lee/Zane, aim to upload final CSV and raw telemetry to S3 and attach link in runbook. I'll schedule partner sync Mon 10am PT to review acceptance criteria.
lee: Ack, will push runbook draft link to internal runbook page.
zane: Ack, will validate pmu scripts and smoke today.
marta: Thanks team. If partner provides kernel blob, don't run on other rigs until verified.
